subject: Mathematics A Level
note: Cambridge International AS & A Level Mathematics 9709, 2026-2027 syllabus. Topic names and the `papers` scoping follow the official Content overview (syllabus p9): section 1 Pure Mathematics 1 = Paper 1, 3 Pure Mathematics 3 = Paper 3, 4 Mechanics = Paper 4, 5 Probability & Statistics 1 = Paper 5. Paper 2 (Pure 2, a subset of Pure 3) and Paper 6 (Probability & Statistics 2) are out of scope. Trigonometry, Differentiation and Integration appear in both Pure 1 and Pure 3 with different content, so they carry a paper suffix. Keywords use plain text as it appears in extracted Cambridge PDF text, not LaTeX: note that theta often extracts as the digit 1 or the letter i, so complex-number keywords avoid bare numeric-plus-i patterns.
